title: Which teams have qualified for the FIFA World Cup 2026 knockouts, round of 32?
byline: Here’s everything you need to know about the FIFA World Cup 2026 knockout stage, including the Round of 32 qualification rules, tiebreaker criteria, qualified teams and nations eliminated from the tournament.

title: Alleged mastermind behind Rs. 21 Billion illegal Dollar transfer network arrested
byline: The Financial Investigation Division has arrested the alleged mastermind behind a large-scale money laundering operation accused of illegally transferring more than Rs. 21 billion (over US$700 million) out of Sri Lanka under the guise of importing goods.

title: Police sound alarm over social media romance scams
byline: The Sri Lanka Police has issued a public advisory warning citizens, particularly women, to remain vigilant against romance scams and other forms of fraud carried out through social media and digital communication platforms.

title: IMF team to visit Sri Lanka next week to review reform programme
byline: A team from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) will visit Sri Lanka from June 24 to June 30 for a staff mission aimed at reviewing recent economic developments and the country’s ongoing reform programme.

title: Iran negotiators, Vance head for Switzerland but Lebanon fighting continues
byline: A high-level Iranian team arrived in Switzerland on ​Saturday for peace talks with the U.S., Iranian state media reported, as U.S. Vice President JD Vance departed Washington for meetings that Pakistan said will begin on Sunday.

title: UK PM Starmer ready to quit
byline: Britain’s Observer newspaper said Prime Minister Keir Starmer was expected to resign on Monday and set ‌out a timetable for his departure, though a government source said Starmer remained focused on getting on with the job of governing.

title: Sooryavanshi smashes record 11-ball half-century against Sri Lanka A
byline: India A opener Vaibhav Sooryavanshi etched his name into the record books with the fastest half-century in List A cricket during the Tri-Nation Series final against Sri Lanka A at the Rangiri Dambulla International Stadium on Sunday.

title: US-Iran talks to begin in Switzerland as Tehran says it closed Strait of Hormuz
byline: Direct talks between the US and Iran are set to begin in Switzerland despite the Iranian military saying it has closed the Strait of Hormuz again over Israel’s attacks on southern Lebanon.

title: Government must publish full fuel cost breakdown and prove subsidy claims – Namal Rajapaksa
byline: Speaking at a public meeting in Colombo on 20 June 2026, SLPP National Organizer Namal Rajapaksa criticized the government’s handling of the economy, rising living costs, and fuel pricing policies.

title: US and Iran begin talks on initial peace deal in Switzerland
byline: US and Iranian officials have arrived in Switzerland for direct talks after signing an initial agreement to end the war last week.

title: West Indies Women beat Sri Lanka by five wickets
byline: The West Indies Women produced a dominant all-round performance to defeat Sri Lanka Women by five wickets in their Group B encounter of the ICC Women’s T20 World Cup 2026 at Gros Islet, Saint Lucia.

title: India A beat Sri Lanka A by 66 runs to win Tri-Nation A-Series
byline: India A defeated Sri Lanka A by 66 runs to clinch the Tri-Nation A-Series trophy at the Rangiri Dambulla International Stadium on Sunday.

title: France bans alcohol at music festival events under red heatwave alert
byline: France has banned alcohol at some events at a massive national music festival on Sunday as a heatwave pushes temperatures towards record levels.

title: Lunuwila police accused of false implication in heroin trafficking case
byline: Two youths in Lunuwila have filed a Fundamental Rights petition before the Supreme Court alleging that they were unlawfully arrested, falsely implicated in a heroin trafficking case, and wrongfully remanded for more than two months by officers attached to the Lunuwila Police Station.

title: Tourists raise concerns over payments allegedly collected by train guards
byline: Train guards operating on the resumed Nanu Oya–Badulla railway service have allegedly collected money from tourists in exchange for access to train compartments, railway sources said.

title: U.S. Pacific Air Forces Commander arrives in Sri Lanka
byline: General Kevin Schneider, Commander of the U.S. Pacific Air Forces (PACAF), arrived in Sri Lanka today for a three-day official visit aimed at further strengthening the growing defense partnership between the United States and Sri Lanka. As the head of PACAF, General Schneider oversees all U.S. Air Force personnel and assets across the Indo-Pacific region.
